description: Earned-only desk credit. 35 is never sold: no presale, no public sale, no deposits, no redemption. A credit exists only when an allowlisted desk signer lands a signed memo for work published in EARN.md. Supply at mint is the credit ledger total, never an invented number. The mint is unpublished and does not exist until scripts/gate.js --preflight passes and the owner authorizes it. Not equity, not a SAFE or note, not a claim on any company, not a promise of profit or buyback, not a deposit receipt.
